test.create_query: CREATE TABLE rf_stats_perf_fact ( p UInt16, id UInt64, k UInt64, k32 UInt32, kn Nullable(UInt64), kf Float64, v UInt64 ) ENGINE = MergeTree PARTITION BY p ORDER BY id SETTINGS auto_statistics_types = 'basic'
CREATE TABLE rf_stats_perf_comp_pk (p UInt16, tenant_id UInt64, k UInt64, v UInt64) ENGINE = MergeTree PARTITION BY p ORDER BY (tenant_id, k) SETTINGS auto_statistics_types = 'basic'

CREATE TABLE rf_stats_perf_nullable_str ( p UInt16, id UInt64, s_sparse Nullable(String), s_dense Nullable(String), v UInt64 ) ENGINE = MergeTree PARTITION BY p ORDER BY id SETTINGS auto_statistics_types = 'basic'
CREATE TABLE rf_stats_perf_many_parts (p UInt16, id UInt64, k UInt64, v UInt64) ENGINE = MergeTree PARTITION BY p ORDER BY id SETTINGS auto_statistics_types = 'basic'
CREATE TABLE rf_stats_perf_dim_exact (k UInt64) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY k
CREATE TABLE rf_stats_perf_dim_band (k UInt64) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY k
CREATE TABLE rf_stats_perf_dim_spread (k UInt64) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY k
CREATE TABLE rf_stats_perf_dim_str (s String) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY s
CREATE TABLE rf_stats_perf_dim_many (k UInt64) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY k
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO rf_stats_perf_fact SELECT intDiv(number, 1000000) AS p, number, number, toUInt32(number), if(p % 2 = 1, NULL, number), if(number % 100000 = 0, nan, toFloat64(number)), number % 1000 FROM numbers(32000000) SETTINGS max_partitions_per_insert_block = 64
INSERT INTO rf_stats_perf_comp_pk SELECT intDiv(number, 1000000), number % 1000, number, number % 1000 FROM numbers(32000000) SETTINGS max_partitions_per_insert_block = 64

INSERT INTO rf_stats_perf_nullable_str SELECT intDiv(number, 500000) AS p, number, if(p = 16, toString(number % 10000), NULL), if(number % 17 = 0, NULL, toString(number % 10000)), number % 1000 FROM numbers(16000000) SETTINGS max_partitions_per_insert_block = 64
INSERT INTO rf_stats_perf_many_parts SELECT intDiv(number, 50000), number, number, number % 1000 FROM numbers(6400000) SETTINGS max_partitions_per_insert_block = 256
INSERT INTO rf_stats_perf_dim_exact SELECT 16000000 + number * 1000 FROM numbers(100)
INSERT INTO rf_stats_perf_dim_band SELECT 16000000 + number FROM numbers(20000)
INSERT INTO rf_stats_perf_dim_spread SELECT number * 100000 FROM numbers(320)
INSERT INTO rf_stats_perf_dim_str SELECT toString(number * 100) FROM numbers(50)
INSERT INTO rf_stats_perf_dim_many SELECT number * 50000 + 42 FROM numbers(128)
test.query: SELECT count(), sum(f.v) FROM rf_stats_perf_fact AS f INNER JOIN rf_stats_perf_dim_exact AS d ON f.k = d.k
SELECT count(), sum(f.v) FROM rf_stats_perf_fact AS f INNER JOIN rf_stats_perf_dim_band AS d ON f.k = d.k SETTINGS join_runtime_filter_exact_values_limit = 100
SELECT count(), sum(f.v) FROM rf_stats_perf_fact AS f INNER JOIN (SELECT k + 1000000000 AS k FROM rf_stats_perf_dim_exact) AS d ON f.k = d.k
SELECT count(), sum(f.v) FROM rf_stats_perf_comp_pk AS f INNER JOIN rf_stats_perf_dim_exact AS d ON f.k = d.k
SELECT count(), sum(f.v) FROM rf_stats_perf_fact AS f INNER JOIN rf_stats_perf_dim_exact AS d ON f.kn = d.k
SELECT count(), sum(f.v) FROM rf_stats_perf_nullable_str AS f INNER JOIN rf_stats_perf_dim_str AS d ON f.s_sparse = d.s
SELECT count(), sum(f.v) FROM rf_stats_perf_nullable_str AS f INNER JOIN rf_stats_perf_dim_str AS d ON f.s_dense = d.s
SELECT count(), sum(f.v) FROM rf_stats_perf_fact AS f INNER JOIN (SELECT toFloat64(k) AS k FROM rf_stats_perf_dim_exact) AS d ON f.kf = d.k
SELECT count(), sum(f.v) FROM rf_stats_perf_fact AS f INNER JOIN rf_stats_perf_dim_exact AS d ON f.k32 = d.k
SELECT count(), sum(f.v) FROM rf_stats_perf_fact AS f INNER JOIN rf_stats_perf_dim_spread AS d ON f.k = d.k
SELECT count(), sum(f.v) FROM rf_stats_perf_fact AS f INNER JOIN rf_stats_perf_dim_spread AS d ON f.k = d.k SETTINGS join_runtime_filter_exact_values_limit = 10
SELECT count(), sum(f.v) FROM rf_stats_perf_many_parts AS f INNER JOIN rf_stats_perf_dim_many AS d ON f.k = d.k
SELECT count(), sum(f.v) FROM rf_stats_perf_fact AS f INNER JOIN rf_stats_perf_dim_exact AS d ON f.id = d.k
SELECT count(), sum(f.v) FROM rf_stats_perf_fact AS f INNER JOIN rf_stats_perf_dim_spread AS d ON f.id = d.k
